column2: [intro]
In my skillet, the onion dances the salsa,
With the peppers, it’s a full-on fiesta.
Spinach grooves to the rhythm of the gratin,
In my lasagna, they put on a divine show, no din.
Veggie lasagna, it’s my true devotion,
An explosion of flavors, a savory potion.
In my kitchen, I’m the star chef for sure,
With my veggies, fun and flavor are pure.
In the oven, my lasagna cooks to a tune,
The tomato sauce twirls like a cartoon.
Mushrooms add their special flair,
In each bite, a burst of flavor beyond compare.
Veggie lasagna is pure magic,
A symphony of tastes, it’s truly fantastic.
With zucchini and creamy béchamel delight,
I promise a culinary experience, out of sight.
[ solo ]
Veggie lasagna, it’s my passion,
An explosion of flavors, an invitation.
In my kitchen, I’m the star chef indeed,
With my veggies, fun and flavor exceed.
[outro]
